name: Yuji Itadori
knownAs: The Tiger of West Junior High

abilities.name: Superhuman Strength
abilities.description: Yuji has exceptional natural strength, speed, reflexes, durability, and stamina.

abilities.name: Hand-to-Hand Combat
abilities.description: A highly skilled martial artist who combines physical attacks with cursed energy.

abilities.name: Divergent Fist
abilities.description: A punch followed by a delayed second impact when cursed energy trails behind the physical strike.

abilities.name: Black Flash
abilities.description: A precisely timed cursed energy impact that greatly amplifies a physical strike.

abilities.name: Blood Manipulation
abilities.description: Allows Yuji to manipulate his own blood after becoming a Death Painting Womb.

abilities.name: Shrine
abilities.description: An awakened technique engraved in Yuji that creates cutting lines, including Dismantle.

abilities.name: Reverse Cursed Technique
abilities.description: Allows Yuji to heal his own injuries.

abilities.name: Simple Domain
abilities.description: An anti-domain technique that neutralizes a domain's barrier and sure-hit effect.

domain.name: Hometown Domain
abilities: Recreates Yuji's hometown and familiar landmarks.
Uses a soul-rending Dismantle as its sure-hit effect without requiring physical contact.
